mapper.update: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS cf_rating_history ( id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, user_id BIGINT NOT NULL, contest_id INT NOT NULL, contest_name VARCHAR(255) NULL, `rank` INT NULL, old_rating INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, new_rating INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, rated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, created_time DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, UNIQUE KEY uk_user_contest (user_id, contest_id), INDEX idx_user_rated (user_id, rated_at) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cf_rating_history (user_id, contest_id, contest_name, `rank`, old_rating, new_rating, rated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{contestId}, #{contestName}, #{rank}, #{oldRating}, #{newRating}, #{ratedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, contest_id, contest_name, `rank`, old_rating, new_rating, rated_at FROM cf_rating_history WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY rated_at ASC, contest_id ASC
